visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen visual appears: the top shows a man drinking coffee directly from a large glass carafe, while the bottom shows a young man in a black textured jacket speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. Large yellow and white captions occupy the middle. (2) The scene transitions to a historical oil painting of a European nobleman (King Gustav III) wearing a blue sash, followed by a cartoon animation of Snow White drinking coffee from a dispenser. (3) An animation shows two prisoners in striped uniforms; one is surrounded by three coffee cups and the other by three tea cups. A photo of a scientist in a yellow coat and a cartoon of two doctors follow, representing the experimental setup. (4) Close-up B-roll shows tea and coffee being poured into cups, followed by high-definition shots of roasted coffee beans and a sleek black GE Profile espresso machine. (5) A series of quick cuts highlights the machine's features: a finger pressing a digital button, coffee flowing into a glass cup, the slim 18cm profile, and a glowing purple LED interface. (6) The narrator returns to the screen, now accompanied by cartoon overlays of the doctors and King with halos and wings, signifying their death. (7) An animation shows the tea-drinking prisoner becoming an elderly man with white hair, while the coffee drinker remains mysterious. (8) The narrator concludes the video in a studio setting, gesturing towards the camera as the background stays out of focus.
